title: SiteReportRepository
responsibility: Presents the report store as one site may see it: reports of another application are absent.

inputs.name: SiteReportRepository.get.id
inputs.description: The id of the report to read: a random UUID given at begin, and also the name of that report's directory under runs. Any value outside 1 to 100 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens or underscores is rejected before the store is read.

outputs.name: SiteReportRepository.get
outputs.description: The report as its manifest.json records it, resolved only when ownedBySite confirms that its project belongs to this site: a checkout of the same application (same repository identity), or the site's own directory when the site is not in a Git repository. For any other report the promise rejects instead.

examples.title: Cart totals review
examples.summary: Cart totals were not exercised; no checks were recorded.

errors.name: SiteReportNotFoundError
errors.description: Thrown with the message 'ENOENT: no such report on this site' when ownedBySite is false for the report's project, so the report reads as absent; it is the only error this method throws itself.

errors.name: Invalid report or asset ID
errors.description: Thrown through ReportRepository.get with the message 'Invalid report or asset ID' when the id is not 1 to 100 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, before any file is read.

errors.name: ReportRepository.get failure
errors.description: Thrown through ReportRepository.get with the message 'Invalid report directory' when the report's directory under runs is a symbolic link.

errors.name: Published report directory or manifest read failure
errors.description: A Node file-system error, for example with code ENOENT, thrown through ReportRepository.get by lstat when no directory exists under runs for the id, or by readFile when that directory has no manifest.json.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown through ReportRepository.get by JSON.parse when the report's manifest.json is not valid JSON.

errors.name: Site Git store real path resolution failure
errors.description: A Node file-system error thrown by realpathSync while the identity of a checkout without a remote is resolved, when its Git store path cannot be resolved; ownedBySite does not catch it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by fileURLToPath while the identity of a checkout is resolved from a file:// origin that cannot be converted to a local path; ownedBySite does not catch it.
